spans.s: ज्या vi. 9P (pp. जिन; pres. जिनाति) To become old, to decay.
ज्या f. 1. A bowstring, ज्यानिनादमथ गृह्णंती तयोः R.xi.15, Megh.ii.10; 2. the earth; 3. a mother; 4. the chord of an arc.
ज्यानि f. 1. Old age, decay; 2. quitting, abandoning; 3. a river, a stream.

ज्यायस् a. (f. सी; compar. of प्रशस्य and वृद्ध) 1. Superior, more excellent, more worthy, Bg.iii.18, M.iii.137; 2. larger, greater; 3. elder, senior; 4. come of age and answerable for his own conduct (in law).
